design.const: constant series (all ones; revin -> the zero patch, h(0))
design.winding: last token = 16th patch; phase = 2 pi frac(15 b) for a tone with phase phi=0; phase 0 bands {4.0, 4.8, 5.0, 5.2, 5.8, 6.0, 6.2, 8.0}, phase pi bands {5.1, 5.3, 5.9} (4.58 / 5.33 / 5.35 are other)
design.grad_E: grad_h of E_b(h) = ||P_b ser(h)||^2 / o, ser = median quantile channel of the raw head output (== the forecast: revin is the identity at the last patch for these unit-power tones)
design.grad_ref_own: grad E_b at h(b) for b in {4, 4.58, 5.33, 8}; at h(4.8) for the nulls b in {5, 6} (per spec)
component_conventions: primary: independent unit projection of h(5.0) on grad E_b (non-orthogonal set, each component literally along grad E_b)
design.component_scaling: each fed component scaled to the reference working norm ||h(4.8)||
design.h1h2: u_interp = normalised mean of the two phase-matched flanks; band 5 flanks ['4.8', '5.2'], band 6 flanks ['5.8', '6.2']; h_par = <h,u>u, h_perp = h-h_par
design.spectrum: ||P_f ser||^2/L in band units on SPEC_GRID (0.5..9.0 step 0.05); unit-power tone reads 1 at its own band

gradE.synthesis_note: E_b at h(b) ~ 1 for the bands the head can emit (4, 4.58, 5.33, 8) and ~ 0 for the nulls (5, 6): the head has clean synthesis directions for 4.58 and 5.33 but none for 5.0 or 6.0

P1_phase_matched_vs_flipped.note: 'holds' is the signed reading; the phase-matched flank is not specially close in magnitude, so P1 is checked both ways

P2b_state_is_itself_at_the_wrong_frequen.note: a true '5.33-state' would show cos(h(5),h(5.33)) ~ 1 and cos(d5,d533) ~ 1; a near-null both ways means the state is not on the 5.33 manifold ray

P4_h1h2.note: H2 needs most of ||h|| on the working-flank direction; the shares are ~5-10%, so the state is not mostly on the right trained mode

head_can_synthesize_the_input_band_after.note: the grad E_5 component (only ~10% of ||h(5.0)||) still drives a clean band-5 output when rescaled, so the head *can* emit band 5; the null input simply carries almost no content on that direction

verdicts.P1: NOT SUPPORTED. Band 5: cos(h5,h4.8) = -0.049 (phase-matched) vs cos(h5,h5.1) = -0.146 (phase-flipped) -- both ~90 deg apart, so the matched flank is only marginally higher in angle (92.8 vs 98.4 deg) while being smaller in |cos|; the other phase-matched flank h(5.2) gives +0.143. Band 6: cos(h6,h8) = -0.063 (matched) vs cos(h6,h5.9) = -0.008 (flipped) -- the FLIPPED flank is angularly closer. The state displacement across the null boundary is therefore a ~90 deg rotation, not the tiny displacement P1 presupposes.
verdicts.P2: SUPPORTED in |cos| for band 5, with the misrouted 4.58 (not the input 5.0) strongest: |cos(grad E_b, d5)| ranks 4.58 (0.27-0.30) > 5.33 (0.15-0.19) > 5.0 (0.099) > 6.0 (0.03) > 8.0 (<0.01), stable across phi = 0/0.83/1.94. The signed cosine is negative for 4.58/5.33 and positive for 5.0, but the sign is immaterial to a quadratic band energy (feeding +v and -v gives the same E_b). The alignments are modest (max ~0.3), and for band 6 every alignment is <=0.07 -> no-tone region (H1) for b=6.
verdicts.P3: SUPPORTED: the grad E_4.58 component reproduces the 4.58 lobe (the highest cosine to the misrouted output) and the grad E_5.33 component reproduces the 5.33/5.35 peak; the grad E_5.0 component does not reproduce the baseline.
verdicts.P4: H1: only ~5-10% of ||h|| lies on the working-flank direction, so the state is not mostly on the right trained mode (H2 rejected); h_perp alone reproduces the whole misrouted output.
verdicts.refinement_c: PARTIAL: the null state leans toward the working null-neighbour region (|cos| ~0.3 with h(5.3)/h(5.33)) rather than toward the phase-matched working flank (|cos| ~0.05), and its read-out is built from grad E_5.33 + grad E_4.58; but it is not a 5.33-state (cos(h5,h5.33) = 0.30, not ~1), and the two nulls 5 and 6 share a distinct direction (cos 0.84) ~70 deg from every working tone.
